description: The company's groups of people — 'Accounting', 'Reviewers' — to whom rights are given at once: a role on a project, a wiki page's read or edit restriction, a grant of one issue or page. A person's rights are their own and their groups' together. To the company's administrator each group with its members, the projects it is on and in which role, and how many restrictions and grants name it; to anybody else of the company the names alone. Not groups of projects (list_project_groups).
name: list_user_groups
title: List user groups
